## Summary

Describe the problem and the observable behavior introduced by this change.

## Compatibility

Describe any impact on schemas, Providers, hosts, CLI output, SDK consumers, or published examples. Write `None` when there is no compatibility impact.

## Verification

List the commands and focused scenarios used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run verify` passes.
- [ ] Public TypeScript types and JSON Schemas agree.
- [ ] New protocol behavior has tests and at least one example.
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese documentation remain behaviorally equivalent.
- [ ] Runtime code remains compatible with Node.js 20+.
- [ ] No generated output, secrets, or private workflow content is included.
